method: One model judge (this session's Claude) reading each document and answering the five Production ownership criteria in ../production-ownership.json, without sight of the deterministic answers. Written down rather than called live: scripts/agreement_harness.py exists but this environment has no provider credentials. The file shape is one (provider, sample) worth of criterion answers, which is what 06 would have to emit for criterion agreement to be measurable.
